title: Recurrence for index probability
statement: Let $D$ be a positive natural number, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $A$ be a decidable property of finite lists of elements of $\text{Fin}(D)$. The probability that a uniformly chosen list of length $k+1$ satisfies $A$ equals $1/D$ times the sum, over all $i\in\text{Fin}(D)$, of the probability that the list obtained by prepending $i$ to a uniformly chosen list of length $k$ satisfies $A$.
hypotheses_covered: A decidable property of lists of elements of Fin(D)
